name: EntertainmentVsSavings

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.background: They want to save more without eliminating enjoyable activities

scenario_template.topic: Comparing how much they spend on entertainment
scenario_template.note: They discuss concerts, restaurants, streaming, hobbies, and nights out

scenario_template.topic: Realizing entertainment is interfering with a savings goal
scenario_template.note: Neither wants to completely give up social activities

scenario_template.topic: Finding a balanced discretionary spending limit
scenario_template.note: They ask how to budget for fun without feeling restricted

scenario_template.topic: Creating a flexible entertainment allowance
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests setting a defined amount rather than eliminating fun spending

scenario_template.topic: Choosing which activities provide the most value
scenario_template.note: They prioritize meaningful experiences over automatic spending

scenario_template.topic: Handling an unusually expensive social month
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them compensate without abandoning the plan

scenario_template.topic: Agreeing on a fun-money limit
scenario_template.note: They feel the plan supports both enjoyment and savings

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
